evidence.notes: Classic stored text and HTML templates merge who and what fields and expand local Attachment plus ContentDocument/ContentVersion files for NONE, METADATA_ONLY, and METADATA_WITH_BODY.
The local runtime accepts the five-argument overload while usage mutation remains a hosted-service row unless a local usage field is represented.

source.content:
@isTest private class CoreRuntimeMessagingRenderTemplateFullLocalTest { @isTest static void rows() { Messaging.SingleEmailMessage withBody = Messaging.renderStoredEmailTemplate((Id)'00X000000000010AAA', (Id)'003000000000010AAA', (Id)'001000000000010AAA', Messaging.AttachmentRetrievalOption.METADATA_WITH_BODY); System.assertEquals('Hello Ada at TrailWorks', withBody.getSubject()); System.assertEquals('

Ada Trail / TrailWorks

', withBody.getHtmlBody()); System.assertEquals('Ada Trail / TrailWorks', withBody.getPlainTextBody()); System.assertEquals(2, withBody.getFileAttachments().size()); System.assertEquals('contract.txt', withBody.getFileAttachments()[0].getFileName()); System.assertEquals('contract body', withBody.getFileAttachments()[0].getBody().toString()); Messaging.SingleEmailMessage metadataOnly = Messaging.renderStoredEmailTemplate((Id)'00X000000000010AAA', (Id)'003000000000010AAA', (Id)'001000000000010AAA', Messaging.AttachmentRetrievalOption.METADATA_ONLY); System.assertEquals(2, metadataOnly.getFileAttachments().size()); System.assertEquals(null, metadataOnly.getFileAttachments()[0].getBody()); Messaging.SingleEmailMessage none = Messaging.renderStoredEmailTemplate((Id)'00X000000000010AAA', (Id)'003000000000010AAA', (Id)'001000000000010AAA', Messaging.AttachmentRetrievalOption.NONE); System.assertEquals(0, none.getFileAttachments().size()); } }
